title: Has anyone else gotten a packet with their grades
content: I had a dream about two night ago where I was in mall world and had been given a thick packet that is pages upon pages long that listed all my grades. My grades were mostly A’s,B’s and B-. However, one of my grades was highlighted in red with a B- (the only B-)and 0.25% beside it. Someone in the dream told me that it meant that I’m not doing my best to do things that matter to me and that are best for me. I’m not sure if the person that said that to me was referring to mall world or real life. If they were referring to real life then I already know what it means because I’ve been getting signs from everywhere telling me that my boyfriend is not the right guy for me and that I need to dump him. I do plan on doing that because that is what’s best for me. However, if they were referring to mall world, then I’m completely stumped on what it could mean. Has anyone else gotten the same packet that listed all your grades?
